_doc: History curves of the tennis point model's keys (epochs.TENNIS_POINT_MODEL_MARKETS), read by CONFIDENCE only under epochs.TENNIS_POINT_MODEL (bet.sofa.tennis_point_curves): they REPLACE the installed curves of these keys. Fitted by scripts/sofa/fit_tennis_point_curves.py on the model's walk-forward over the Sofascore history (as of each match), in fit_confidence's format (realised_lo95 = Wilson lower bound).

fitted_from.estimator: bet.sofa.tennis_point_model via tennis_point_sheet (sims 4000, seed = event id)
fitted_from.lines: half lines with OVER p in [0.1, 0.9]
